detail.longDescription: Automattic's board placed co-founder Matt Mullenweg on paid leave September 9, naming finance chief Mark Davies interim CEO. Mullenweg says he received 50 minutes' notice and voted against the move. He retains control of WordPress.org, the open-source project separate from the commercial company. https://www. implicator.ai/automattic-board -mullenweg-paid-leave/ # WordPress # OpenSource # Tech
